verses.1: So Abram went up from Egypt to the Negeb, he and his wife and everything he had, and Lot with him.
verses.2: Abram was very wealthy in livestock, silver, and gold.
verses.3: From the Negeb he traveled on to Bethel, to the place where his tent had been before, between Bethel and Ai,
verses.4: to the place where he had first built an altar. There Abram called on the name of the LORD.
verses.5: Now Lot, who was traveling with Abram, also had flocks, herds, and tents.
verses.6: But the land could not support both of them living there together, for their possessions were so great that they were not able to stay together.
verses.7: And there was conflict between the herdsmen of Abram's livestock and the herdsmen of Lot's livestock. At that time the Canaanites and the Perizzites were also living in the land.
verses.8: So Abram said to Lot, "Let there be no quarreling between you and me, or between your herdsmen and mine, for we are close relatives.
verses.9: Is not the whole land before you? Let us part ways. If you go to the left, I will go to the right. If you go to the right, I will go to the left."
verses.10: Lot looked up and saw that the whole Jordan Valley was well watered everywhere, like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, toward Zoar. This was before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.11: So Lot chose for himself the whole Jordan Valley and set out toward the east. In this way they parted from each other.
verses.12: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, while Lot settled among the cities of the plain and pitched his tent near Sodom.
verses.13: Now the men of Sodom were wicked, great sinners against the LORD.
verses.14: After Lot had parted from him, the LORD said to Abram, "Look up and from the place where you are, look northward and southward and eastward and westward,
verses.15: for all the land that you see I will give to you and to your offspring forever.
verses.16: I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth, so that if anyone could count the dust of the earth, your offspring could also be counted.
verses.17: Get up and walk through the length and breadth of the land, for I will give it to you."
verses.18: So Abram moved his tent and came to live by the oaks of Mamre at Hebron, and there he built an altar to the LORD.

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
